description: EMAIL APPLICATIONS ONLY - Located between Innishannon and Crossbarry, this is a six bedroom UNFURNISHED dormer bungalow with private parking and gardens to the front and side. The property is in excellent condition throughout. Accommodation consists of  living room with solid fuel stove and double doors to conservatory, fully fitted kitchen/dining room, utility room, shower room, three bedrooms with master en-suite on the ground floor and three further bedrooms (one with shower room and one with guest w.c). Heating is oil fired. Strictly no pets allowed. Viewing by appt only.
